messages:
Alex: Quick sync — noticed ~20% drop in prefix-cache hit-rate for model rdx-small on /summarize since kernel selector change last night. dashboard: https://dash.reddemo.internal/d/abcd1234
Mira: saw that on my chart too. token_savings delta ~12k/day. need per-customer split.
TJ: pulled customer slice: AcmeCorp shows 45% drop, BetaInc ~8%. full CSV attached to the alert.
Sam: adding profiler traces now. early suspicions: batching window increased after fallback to generic matmul kernel, so longer KV cache churn.
Elaine: can you paste the logs around the fallback? thinking kv-cache TTL behavior could interact
Alex: logs & grep below
```text
2026-04-23T02:14:03Z kernel: selected generic_matmul for rdx-small seq=512
2026-04-23T02:14:03Z batching: window_ms adjusted 50->150 due to throughput heuristic
2026-04-23T02:14:04Z kv-cache: evicted prefix keys for tenant=acmecorp count=124
```
Sam: that batching change would increase per-request latency and cause more cache key churn — explains hit-rate dip.
Mira: ops: any canary traffic affected (dedicated vs hosted)?
Alex: mostly hosted. Dedicated pools unaffected.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423 — team eng-runtime assigned
TJ: plan: revert kernel selector override for rdx-small in canary then prod if ok. also add temporary batching cap: `max_window_ms=80` for rdx-small.
Elaine: also add dashboard tiles: (1) per-model/per-route token_saved timeseries, (2) per-customer cumulative token_savings, (3) kernel_version dimension slice, (4) cache-hit-lag histogram.
Sam: made a quick query: `SELECT model, route, customer, sum(tokens_saved) FROM prefix_cache WHERE ts > now()-24h GROUP BY 1,2,3` — AcmeCorp shows -11k tokens vs baseline.
Mira: recommend alert: rate of change on tokens_saved per-customer > 10% over 1h -> pager to eng-runtime oncall.
Alex: I'm pushing canary rollback now: `deploy rollback --service=kernel-selector --version=2026-04-22`
Sam: starting profiler capture on canary nodes. link: https://perf.reddemo.internal/trace/xyz
TJ: FYI, key-normalizer change from yesterday changed fingerprinting salt -> mismatched key shapes for seeded warmup; I'm toggling `use_old_normalizer=true` in staging.
Elaine: after rollback, we'll need a follow-up: add a kernel selection A/B test and gating on prefix-cache hit-rate delta <5%.
Mira: noted. i'll open a short PR for dashboard tiles and alert rules.
Alex: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
